query:
SELECT weekNumber, campus, subgroup, headcount, weekStartDate, updatedAt
FROM attendance_weekly 
WHERE year = 2026 AND weekNumber IN (17, 18) 
  AND campus = 'Canton' AND subgroup = 'Revolution Canton Check-In'
ORDER BY weekNumber;
